h2cnl_x_extra.build: p = softmax(l2_common.lon6(refcv6_extras['nav_true.tacv6_lon_logits'][row])) in float64, softmax(l) = exp(l - max(l)) / sum; row = the extras row of the SAME forward joined on (clip_index, ws); X = concat[progress_scalar.feats (10 cols, col 0 = 1), p], standardised with xmu / xsd like every X column (l1_fit_score.mlp_inputs)
